eyebrow: Built for every role on the team
heading: One orchestrator. Every workflow.
description: Helix adapts to the way each member of your team ships code — so atomic work-breakdown is useful from the first commit to the last review.

items.title: Move from idea to PR without losing the thread
items.description: Describe the goal in plain language and Helix returns reviewable units — with types, tests, and a clean diff for each one.
outcomes: Skip the blank-page paralysis on big refactors
Keep personal projects on a real, auditable cadence
Ship side projects without babysitting long-running agents
items.quote: It feels like pair-programming with a teammate who actually remembers the last ten PRs.

items.title: Move fast without breaking things
items.description: Atomic PRs keep main green and give you a paper trail your investors can actually verify.
outcomes: Fewer late-night hotfixes from sprawling AI diffs
items.quote: Helix is the first orchestrator that ships work I can confidently put in front of customers.

items.title: Predictable AI delivery
items.description: Plan features, not vibes. Clear scope per unit, traceable end-to-end.
outcomes: Clear scope per unit, traceable end-to-end
Tell stakeholders what shipped and why
items.quote: I can finally answer 'what did we ship this week?' with a unit-by-unit story.

items.title: Forecast, parallelize, and unblock with confidence
items.description: Helix surfaces what is parallelizable, what is blocked, and where reviewers should focus — turning orchestrator output into engineering signal.
outcomes: Identify blockers in real time across active runs
Turn orchestrator output into engineering signal
items.quote: The atomic unit of work is finally visible end-to-end.

items.title: Handoff-ready output for every client repo
items.description: Helix produces PRs that any client's team can review, replay, or revert — without re-learning the AI's plan.
outcomes: Replayable run logs handed off to client teams
Per-unit revert paths that don't disturb other work
items.quote: Our clients get handoffs they actually want to read.
